Do not commit, push, change branches, edit the task, or start another watcher; the parent runner handles delivery. Respect allowed_paths and base version. Write real deliverables and perform checks. Report blockers rather than inventing parameters. The task is authorized; continue through routine fixes.
Implement the accounting, metrics and equal-weight baseline in specs/ACCOUNTING.md exactly, with plain documented Python APIs. Add a baseline simulator that accepts already selected rows for ONE scenario and explicit horizon, returns a complete per-period ledger plus metrics, and never combines scenarios. Test the exact bill-to-equity 20-unit example, initial equal weight, no trade, zero fees/returns, inflation-only loss, wealth conservation, nonnegative full investment and a hand-computable two-period case. Show how a decision callback would be restricted to a history prefix without implementing a full policy yet. Avoid adding unrequested dependencies. Put all tests in tests/test_accounting.py and explain APIs, independent expected numbers, unresolved conventions and limitations in your review. Use only synthetic toy fixtures or development rows. This is implementation ready for coordinator review, not a final modeling conclusion.
